evidence.C1: The first job is 'shorter' and the car is indestructible, but the initial objective is 115m away (Image 2), which risks exceeding the 60-second anchor for a confused stranger.
evidence.C2: Distinct districts and lighting (Sol Wheel, Meridian crowns) create mood, but the Rustport quay ground (Image 13) is a flat yellow plane lacking the detail of the cranes and containers.
evidence.C3: Perks 'tie the side activities together' and money sinks (property, tune-up) ensure 'jobs, police, money sinks and secrets... feed each other'.
evidence.C4: Gate G8 passed (no overlaps), and the HUD is minimal ('cash and health... stars appear only when you are wanted'), reading at a glance.
evidence.C5: The fact sheet plainly states 'No real players have tried it yet' and details exactly what was tested by script versus AI judges.

fixes: Reduce the distance to the first job objective or add a 'Follow' arrow to guarantee a stranger can finish within 60 seconds.
Add ground decals (oil, cracks, gravel) to the Rustport quay area to match the high detail of the industrial buildings and cranes.
Make the 'on foot' requirement for jobs like the Paper Round more prominent in the UI to prevent players from driving to the location.

evidence.C1: Spawn banner 'Get into the red car ahead [F]' with 'JOB 335 m'; idle 3.5 s shows walking keys; learner phase means the first minute 'cannot end in an arrest' or 'a burning car'; job 1 passes 5/5 key-press runs in 38.5-50.9 s - only a stranger's unverified sub-minute finish and the text-heavy title screen keep it from 10.
evidence.C2: Dusk Sol Wheel shot (pink sky, lit wheel, palms, beach) and the night glow pass are one-screenshot recognisable; 'Meridian towers are aqua, coral, cream and lilac'; but the Rustport container yard and some street views stay flat-coloured beside the best scenes.
evidence.C3: Six story jobs, five odd-job kinds, cab fares, courier shift, property rent, 15 packages, perks ('10 cab fares double tips') and heat refusals tie systems together; but all five odd jobs are timed collect/deliver marker variants, and races/getaway difficulty is unmeasured.
evidence.C4: 'the HUD is cash and health; the stars appear only when you are wanted'; G8 'no overlaps at 3 sizes'; gains show 'green or red... under the cash figure'; the thin health/car-condition bars read least at speed.
evidence.C5: 'Own city, names and art' plus the title disclaimer; 'Not covered by the tests' states limits unusually plainly; yet the skeleton (wanted stars, respray, hidden packages) deliberately mirrors the series it 'is often compared to'.

fixes: Rebalance job 4 / police aggression: key-press runs fail 1 of 3 (arrested or taken out, 7-minute timeout), and the script-passed races (jobs 3, 6) and 3-star getaway have never had their difficulty measured for a human.
Differentiate the five odd jobs beyond timed collect/deliver marker runs (Rush Order, Repo Run, Block Dash, Hot Parcel, Paper Round) so ten minutes of post-story play vary more.
Playtest with real newcomers: driving feel, radio pleasantness and a stranger's first-minute timing are unverified (the script itself needs 38.5-50.9 s for job 1).
